milestone.title: 2.0 GA release — JSON-native agent-first toolkit ship

intent.outcome: Master Plan toolkit ships as a coherent 2.0.0 release: lean JSON plan persistence, fragment-first agent I/O, search v2, dogfood doc split, size-aware positioning docs, updated brief/charter (TOML→JSON, clean-break), release map reflects the real milestone set, CHANGELOG and version tag cut, make install refreshes harness assets.

problem.description: 2.0.0-rc.1/rc.2 shipped the mp/raul split and early agent JSON defaults, but plan.toml still lists 2.0.0 GA as only M76+M83+M84. The actual 2.0 thesis — lean spec (M82), JSON on disk (M92), fragment ops (M93), search v2 (M95), dogfood ergonomics (M90), size-aware positioning (M81) — has no release capstone. Brief constraints still say TOML and backward compatibility while M92 is a clean break. Without a GA milestone, the JSON/agent-first wave ships piecemeal with no adoption checkpoint, stale release registry, and drift between docs and product reality.

in_scope: Refresh master-plan/plan.toml releases: 2.0.0 planned milestone list includes M82, M90, M92, M93, M95, M81, M96 (and already-shipped rc members as documented)
mp milestone set-target-version for 2.0.0 GA members verified consistent with release registry
Update master-plan/brief.toml T04 constraints: JSON on disk, 2.0 clean break (no TOML plan artifacts, no back-compat shims)
Update charter if needed to reflect agent-first JSON and goal-2 fragment ops
CHANGELOG.md: generate or finalize 2.0.0 section from completed milestones (mp changelog generate or manual curation)
Version tag 2.0.0 + release notes (Gitea/GitHub per existing release process)
make install — refresh global harness skills/templates after doc changes
mp validate && make test && make test-fixtures && make test-scenarios green on release branch
SESSION-HANDOFF or release note summarizing 2.0 agent workflow (mp search, fragment ops, no grep master-plan/)
out_of_scope: Raul TUI top-tabs (M91) or robustness (M87) — may ship post-GA
Bulk metadata ops (M94) — ships in 2.0 wave but not blocking GA tag if done separately
